metadata.description: Review tooling for AI-generated media, modeled on film and music production workflows

plugins.name: media-preview
plugins.description: Turns generated video, audio, and images into a screening page with a review brief: scoped asks, declared work-in-progress, timecode-anchored comments, OK/retake/hold verdicts, and automated QC (duration, resolution, EBU R128 loudness, true peak, missing audio track). Runs fully local with no upload and no size limit.
